scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace @investai/shared && concurrently "npm run dev --workspace @investai/api" "npm run dev --workspace @investai/web"
scripts.dev:api: npm run build --workspace @investai/shared && npm run dev --workspace @investai/api
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @investai/shared && npm run build --workspace @investai/api && npm run build --workspace @investai/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @investai/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace @investai/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace @investai/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @investai/web
